heading: Weekday visits
text: Visitors are welcome between 12:00 and 21:00 on weekdays. Each patient may receive at most 4 visitors at the same time.

heading: Intensive care
text: Intensive care visits are limited to 11 minutes and one visitor at a time. Visitors must wear the gown provided at the unit door.
embeddingText:
Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Visiting Hours > Intensive care
Intensive care visits are limited to 11 minutes and one visitor at a time. Visitors must wear the gown provided at the unit door.

heading: Children
text: Children under 12 may visit only together with an adult. Flowers and food from outside are not allowed in patient rooms.
